cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Choose What Matters More
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between emotional safety and the outcome they claim to want.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll settle the lease over dinner. Do you want my honest answer about living together?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. Just don't say anything that makes me panic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can order first. But shall I answer after, even if it upsets you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Answer. But start by saying we're fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I can't begin yet. Choose dinner or my answer; I'll put the lease away if it's dinner.
